source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: While any Icons of Khorne are in the bearer's unit, you get 1 Bloodshed point for each enemy unit it **destroys**. Whenever you roll for [Blessings of Khorne](vsdata:ability/world-eaters.blessings-of-khorne), add a D6 to that roll per Bloodshed point you have, then you lose all your Bloodshed points.

detail.gate: bearer unit has at least one Icon of Khorne
